categoryName: Bags, luggage, umbrellas, raincoats, belts, wallets, travel accessories

skuLines.examples: Skybags Genie/Kids, Wildcraft Wiki Jr, Zip+ printed 16L, unbranded Delhi/Ludhiana cartoon-print 14L
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr session start; small Jul-Aug re-buy after monsoon damage
skuLines.notes: Bulky and low value-density — freight per unit is the killer on 30-50 km of hill road; buy nested/compressed in one full load. Keep sizes narrow, colours wide.

skuLines.examples: Skybags Class 07, Wildcraft Wiki Daypack, American Tourister Toodle, Safari Duo
skuLines.notes: CBSE school-bag weight norm (bag ≤10% of body weight) pushes light, dual-compartment, wide-padded-strap builds; avoid single-strap sling styles a school will reject.

skuLines.examples: Skybags trolley, Safari kids trolley, Priority/Zip+ wheeled school bag
skuLines.notes: Confirm with the Academy first — many schools ban wheels on stairs/gravel. Wheels are the #1 failure point and there is no service centre inside 50 km, so stock only brands whose warranty can be claimed by courier.

skuLines.examples: Wildcraft, Trawoc, Adventure Worx, generic PVC/nylon cover
skuLines.notes: Probably the fastest-turning small item in this lane at a heavy-monsoon hill campus. Pre-book in May — the hill supply chain runs dry exactly when everyone needs it.

skuLines.line: Insulated lunch / tiffin bag (kids and staff)
skuLines.examples: Milton Kids, Cello, Signoraware, Jaypee Plus insulated tiffin bag
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr with the tiffin-box buy; year-round trickle
skuLines.notes: Merchandise at the tiffin/kitchen shelf, not in the luggage aisle — it sells attached to the lunch box.

skuLines.examples: Milton bottle cover, Cello sling pouch, generic neoprene 750ml-1L sleeve
skuLines.notes: Cheap, light, high margin — a good impulse hook near school bags.

skuLines.line: Drawstring shoe bag / PT kit bag
skuLines.examples: Nivia drawstring bag, Wildcraft shoe bag, plain polyester school PT bag
skuLines.notes: Often a school-specified item — check whether the Academy wants a plain colour before buying prints.

skuLines.examples: Jayco stainless steel storage peti 10", local GI-sheet trunk 22"/24", Aristocrat metal trunk
skuLines.notes: Heaviest, worst-nesting item in the lane — source Nahan/Chandigarh in a single full truck at intake and hold only two sizes. This is the classic residential-school SKU a city assortment would miss entirely.

skuLines.examples: Kuber Industries quilt bag, Amazon Basics non-woven storage bag, PVC-window blanket bag
skuLines.seasonality: Mar (packing winter bedding away) and Oct (bringing it out)
skuLines.notes: Hill damp ruins stored bedding — insist on a moisture-resistant lining, and cross-sell naphthalene/silica sachets.

skuLines.line: Laundry bag — mesh wash bag + pop-up hamper
skuLines.examples: Kuber mesh laundry bag, generic pop-up nylon hamper, drawstring hostel laundry sack
skuLines.notes: Pure hostel-town demand — 5,000 residents with communal laundry means this never stops moving.

skuLines.examples: Duckback holdall, local rexine bedding bag, Safari/Aristocrat jumbo bag
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-May and Dec term start/end travel
skuLines.notes: Students carrying bedding home by bus; buy shallow, it is a two-window-a-year line.

skuLines.examples: HP/Lenovo OEM backpack, Skybags Offroad, Wildcraft, Gear, American Tourister
skuLines.notes: USB-port, anti-theft and rain-flap variants are now under ₹1,000 — keep one black and one colour, waterproof fabric only given the monsoon.

skuLines.examples: Dell/HP OEM sleeve, Gizga, Istorm, Zipline neoprene sleeve
skuLines.notes: Light, flat, high margin — ideal item to carry deep because freight is negligible.

skuLines.examples: Lavie/Caprese entry tote, Baggit, plain canvas jhola, khadi-style cotton tote
skuLines.notes: Modest, plain, dark colours sell in an institutional township; loud fast-fashion prints sit.

skuLines.examples: Wildcraft sling, Skybags crossbody, Puma/HRX sling, unbranded rexine sling
skuLines.notes: The everyday phone+wallet+gutka carry bag for young men on campus; steady, not seasonal.

skuLines.line: Waist pouch / belt bag / money belt
skuLines.examples: Wildcraft waist pouch, Duckback travel money belt, unbranded rexine kamar-patti pouch
skuLines.seasonality: Travel and yatra windows; Gurpurab/Vaisakhi movement
skuLines.notes: Doubles as the cash-carry for staff on duty, shopkeepers and elderly travellers going to town — a genuinely different job from a wallet.

skuLines.examples: Nivia, Puma/HRX gym duffel, Skybags duffel, Wildcraft Rover
skuLines.notes: Overlaps the hand duffel below — do not double-stock; keep the branded gym look for the university cohort only.

skuLines.line: Cricket / sports kit bag, wheeled, 90-120 cm
skuLines.examples: SG, SS, Nivia wheeled kit bag, DSC kit bag
skuLines.notes: Largely a Trust/sports-department indent rather than walk-in — carry 1-2 pieces and index the rest to order.

skuLines.line: Cabin trolley suitcase 55 cm, hard polypropylene, 4/8 wheel
skuLines.examples: Kamiliant by American Tourister, Safari Pentagon/Thorium, Aristocrat, Alfa by VIP
skuLines.seasonality: May-Jun and Dec-Jan vacation travel; Nov-Feb wedding gifting
skuLines.notes: Hard PP handles hill road and rain far better than soft polyester. Wheels and the telescopic handle are the failure points and there is no local service centre — prefer a courier-claimable warranty.

skuLines.examples: Safari, Aristocrat, Kamiliant, VIP soft-body polyester 26-27"
skuLines.notes: The core size for a student going home for a full vacation. Keep 3-4 colours, one depth each.

skuLines.examples: Safari, VIP, Aristocrat 30-31" hard/soft
skuLines.notes: Slow — one piece per colour is plenty; it occupies enormous shelf cube for its turn.

skuLines.examples: Kamiliant 3-pc set, Safari 2-pc combo, Aristocrat set, Snitch/HRX set
skuLines.seasonality: Nov-Feb wedding season and Diwali gifting
skuLines.notes: A gifting SKU — needs presentable packaging, which roughly doubles freight cube. Buy against the wedding calendar, not by the month.

skuLines.examples: Duckback, Skybags duffel, local rexine 24" bag, Jholawala
skuLines.seasonality: year-round, peaks with every term break
skuLines.notes: The real workhorse here — cheap, folds flat for freight, nothing to break on gravel, and it is what a student actually buys for a bus trip home. Also stock one foldable pack-into-its-own-pouch travel bag (₹200-₹600) beside it.

skuLines.examples: Safari strolley duffel, Skybags Cardiff, Aristocrat wheeled duffel
skuLines.notes: The compromise buy between duffel and suitcase; soft body copes with an overloaded bus roof better than a hard shell.

skuLines.examples: Wildcraft Rucksack, Trawoc, Adventure Worx, Quechua-style generic
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-Jun and Sep-Oct trek, camp and NCC season
skuLines.notes: Sirmaur terrain plus school camps and hikes make this more relevant than in a plains store of the same size; carry rain covers to match.

skuLines.line: Luggage lock, TSA / combination / brass padlock
skuLines.examples: Godrej brass padlock 30-50mm, Safari TSA lock, Flipkart SmartBuy combination lock, Harrison padlock
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; spikes at Apr hostel intake
skuLines.notes: Doubles as the hostel-locker and trunk padlock line, which is why it sells all year in a boarding township, not just at travel time. Keep luggage straps and name tags (₹90-₹350) on the same peg.

skuLines.line: Packing cubes / travel organiser set, 5-7 piece
skuLines.examples: Pack My Bag 7-pc set, Adofys organiser set, Kuber travel pouch set
skuLines.notes: Light and flat — cheap to freight, so it is a low-risk way to add a premium-feeling line.

skuLines.examples: Wildcraft toiletry kit, Milton travel pouch, PVC hostel shower caddy pouch
skuLines.notes: In a hostel this is not a travel item — it is the daily shared-bathroom carry. Keep a wipe-clean PVC version at the cheap end.

skuLines.line: Neck pillow + eye mask travel combo
skuLines.examples: Trekgo memory-foam U pillow, Ofifo combo kit, inflatable neck pillow
skuLines.notes: An 8-12 hour hill bus to Chandigarh/Delhi makes this less of a luxury than it looks on a city shelf.

skuLines.line: Passport / document holder and file-folder bag
skuLines.examples: Solo document bag, Worldone expanding file bag, rexine certificate folder, Saraswati file case
skuLines.seasonality: Jul-Aug admissions, exam-form and placement season
skuLines.notes: Sells as the admission/certificate carrier far more than as a travel item; overlaps the stationery lane — decide who owns it.

skuLines.examples: Kuber luggage cover, transparent PVC trolley cover, printed stretch cover
skuLines.notes: Roof-rack bus travel in monsoon rain is the whole reason this exists here; attach-sell it with every trolley.

skuLines.examples: K.C.Paul & Sons (Adi), Fendo, Cello, Murano, Flipkart SmartBuy 3-fold
skuLines.notes: The single highest-turn line in this whole category at PIN 173101. Buy the season in May — by July the hill supply chain and everyone's need peak together. Stock UV-coated variants to capture the summer-sun buy as well.

skuLines.examples: K.C.Paul long umbrella, Fendo 2-fold, Duckback straight umbrella
skuLines.notes: Double-canopy vented ribs are not a gimmick in valley gusts — cheap 8-rib frames invert and come straight back as complaints.

skuLines.examples: Fendo kids, Cello kids cartoon, Zephira kids umbrella
skuLines.notes: Blunt/rounded tips and a safety-runner only — a residential school will insist. Deepest depth requirement of any umbrella line given the student count.

skuLines.examples: Fendo golf umbrella, K.C.Paul 30", generic 48" garden umbrella
skuLines.notes: Mostly a Trust/department indent (gate, ground, security duty), not a walk-in SKU — carry a token piece and order to requirement.

skuLines.line: Raincoat — adult 2-piece rain suit (jacket + trouser), polyester/PU
skuLines.examples: Duckback rain suit, Zeel, Wildcraft Rain Pro, Versalis
skuLines.notes: Two-wheeler staff are the core buyer. Carry reversible and plain; hi-vis/reflective piping for drivers, security and ground staff on unlit hill roads.

skuLines.line: Raincoat — PVC / EVA long hooded coat (mass entry)
skuLines.examples: Duckback PVC raincoat, unbranded EVA long coat, Sancia/Unox entry raincoat
skuLines.notes: PVC embrittles in cold storage — sell it through inside the season and do not carry stock into a second monsoon.

skuLines.examples: Duckback kids raincoat, Zeel Junior, Baby Bucket, printed EVA kids set
skuLines.notes: The deepest size curve you will need anywhere in this lane — an entire residential school of children 5-18 lives here. Size-out is the whole risk; a stockout means a child walks to class wet.

skuLines.examples: Duckback poncho, transparent PE emergency poncho, EVA reversible poncho
skuLines.notes: A counter impulse, not an aisle item — keep a stack at POS. Also the cover-the-schoolbag solution when the fitted rain cover is out of stock.

skuLines.line: Gumboots / rain boots, PVC, kids and adult sizes
skuLines.examples: Duckback gumboot, Bata gumboot, Harsh/Robustt safety gumboot, Zinda
skuLines.notes: Overlaps the footwear lane — decide once who owns it, or it will be double-bought. Canteen, dairy and ground staff need ISI safety-toe versions; students need plain kids sizes. Bulky, so freight a full monsoon buy in May.

skuLines.examples: Adofys silicone shoe cover, generic PVC overshoe, reusable rain boot cover
skuLines.notes: For teaching and office staff who cannot wear gumboots to class — a cheap, flat, high-margin add-on beside the raincoats.

skuLines.examples: generic IPX8 phone pouch, Wildcraft dry bag 5-20L, Trawoc dry sack
skuLines.packSizes: phone pouch single or 2-pack; 5L/10L/20L dry bag
skuLines.notes: Protects the phone and the documents students carry — sells hard in the first week of real rain and then stops.

skuLines.line: Men's formal leather belt, 32-42", black & brown
skuLines.examples: Woodland, Killer, Peter England, Hidesign entry, Leather Zentrum
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; festive and wedding gifting Oct-Feb
skuLines.notes: Sizes 34-38 cover roughly 70% of demand. Auto-lock/ratchet buckles now outsell pin buckles at the mid price. Cut-to-size belts let you hold fewer SKUs.

skuLines.line: Men's casual canvas / braided / stretch belt
skuLines.examples: Wrogn canvas belt, Roadster braided belt, elastic stretch belt, unbranded PU casual belt
skuLines.notes: Young-adult everyday line; free-size stretch versions kill the size-curve problem.

skuLines.line: School uniform belt (elastic or buckle, with crest)
skuLines.examples: school-spec elastic belt with metal buckle, plain navy/black uniform belt, crested buckle belt
skuLines.notes: Almost always a school-specified item — get the buckle, crest and colour spec from the Academy in writing and run it as an indent line, not an open buy. A wrong buckle is dead stock nobody else will take.

skuLines.line: Kirpan gatra (strap) and kirpan cover / gilaf
skuLines.examples: cotton gatra (white / blue / kesri), leather gatra, embroidered kirpan cover, small & large sizes
skuLines.seasonality: Amrit sanchar camps, Vaisakhi, Gurpurabs, Hola Mohalla
skuLines.notes: A Kalgidhar Trust township — this is a genuine everyday must-have, not a curiosity line, and it is exactly what a mainstream distributor list will not contain. Source from Amritsar/Ludhiana religious-goods wholesalers. Handle and display with respect: never on the floor, never adjacent to footwear or leather goods.

skuLines.line: Gutka Sahib bag / rumala pouch (cloth cover for nitnem gutka)
skuLines.examples: plain cotton gutka bag, embroidered velvet gutka cover, zipped nitnem pouch, rehal cover
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; spikes at Gurpurabs and new-student intake
skuLines.notes: Same religious-goods supply line as the gatra. Keep a plain cotton and an embroidered option. Shelve above and away from footwear/leather — placement is a real sensitivity, not a nicety.

skuLines.line: Men's bifold wallet — artificial leather, entry
skuLines.examples: Flipkart SmartBuy, Urban Leather, Provogue, Wildhorn PU bifold
skuLines.notes: Highest-margin, lowest-freight line in the entire category, and the default ₹200-500 gift on a campus. Carry it deep — it costs almost nothing to hold.

skuLines.examples: Wildhorn genuine leather, Hidesign entry, Woodland wallet, Baggit men
skuLines.notes: RFID-blocking has moved from premium to expected at this price. Gift-boxed versions are what actually sell in the festive window.

skuLines.line: Card holder / coin pouch / slim wallet
skuLines.examples: Urban Leather card holder, metal RFID card case, zip coin pouch, Tanstitch slim wallet
skuLines.notes: Also the ID-card and bus-pass holder for students and staff — pitch it that way, not as a fashion item.

skuLines.examples: Baggit clutch, Lavie entry purse, unbranded rexine ladies purse, Zouk cotton clutch
skuLines.notes: Everyday cash-carry for women staff and staff wives; plain and dark sells, embellished does not.

skuLines.examples: Baggit, Lavie, Caprese entry, Zouk, unbranded PU shoulder bag
skuLines.seasonality: Festive Oct-Nov and wedding season Nov-Feb
skuLines.notes: Keep it modest and plain — a Sikh institutional township is not a fashion-forward market, and loud styles become markdowns. Two shapes, four colours is enough.

skuLines.line: Diaper bag / mother's bag (backpack or tote, insulated pockets)
skuLines.examples: Bumtum, Baybee, 1st Step, Mee Mee, StarAndDaisy mummy bag
skuLines.notes: Married-staff-quarters demand — small but never zero, and nowhere else within 30-50 km sells it. One backpack style plus one tote is the right depth.

skuLines.line: Reusable grocery bag — jute / cotton tote
skuLines.examples: jute shopping bag with laminated lining, cotton tote, jute-cotton combo, store-branded jhola
skuLines.notes: Post single-use-plastic-ban this is a POS revenue line, not an aisle item — and a store-branded jhola is free advertising on a closed campus where every bag is seen. Add a foldable pocket nylon bag (₹60-₹250) for the elderly who walk uphill with groceries.

skuLines.line: Non-woven / PP woven shopping bag, multi-pack
skuLines.examples: non-woven D-cut bag pack of 10-20, PP woven zipped bag, laminated shopper
skuLines.notes: Doubles as the store's own carry bag stock and as a retail line; check the state's current thickness/GSM rule for HP before buying a large lot.

skuLines.examples: Kuber shopping trolley bag, Amazon Basics 2-wheel shopping cart, foldable market trolley
skuLines.notes: Genuinely useful where people walk groceries home uphill and there is no car park at the door — also used by the canteens and F&V counter for internal moves. City stores under-stock this; here it earns its shelf.

skuLines.examples: HDPE woven bag 24x36", jute gunny bag, laminated PP sack
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; F&V and grain intake peaks
skuLines.notes: A warehouse / F&V / canteen consumable rather than a retail SKU — buy in bales and treat it as the store's own operating supply, but it belongs on this category's buying list or nobody orders it.

skuLines.examples: Kuber saree cover set, PVC-window garment cover, non-woven suit cover
skuLines.notes: Damp hill wardrobes and long monsoon make this a real need, not a novelty; sells attached to naphthalene balls and silica sachets.

skuLines.examples: Milton insulated carry bag, generic thermal delivery bag, langar tiffin carrier bag
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; langar/Gurpurab and exam-season mess runs
skuLines.notes: An institutional line for the two canteens, the mess and langar sewa — not a walk-in SKU, so buy to indent rather than to shelf.

trends2026: Hard-shell polypropylene has displaced soft luggage at the entry price: 8-wheel spinners with combination/TSA locks are now standard at ₹1,300-₹1,800 (Kamiliant, Alfa by VIP, Safari, Aristocrat), which is exactly the price point a captive hill store can stock — and PP survives rain and roof-rack travel far better than polyester.

Value sub-brands of the majors (Kamiliant under American Tourister, Alfa under VIP) plus DTC entrants have compressed cabin-trolley entry pricing to roughly the price of a good school bag, so 'branded luggage' is no longer a premium-only shelf.

Q-commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) now runs weather-triggered rain assortments — umbrellas, ponchos, backpack rain covers, shoe covers pushed to the front of the app on rain days. That behaviour has trained buyers to expect instant rain gear, which a 30-50 km-from-market store can only match by pre-booking stock in May.

'Smart' features have gone mass: USB charging ports, anti-theft/lockable zips and rain flaps on sub-₹1,000 laptop backpacks, and RFID-blocking on sub-₹500 wallets. These are now expectations rather than upsells.

Ergonomic school-bag buying driven by the school-bag weight norm (bag ≤10% of the child's body weight): lighter fabrics, dual compartments, wide padded straps and chest clips, and a visible move away from wheeled school trolleys where schools have stairs or gravel.

Single-use-plastic enforcement has turned the reusable carry bag into a permanent POS revenue line — jute, laminated cotton, non-woven multi-packs and store-branded jholas — with GSM/thickness rules that vary by state and get revised.
Recycled-PET and recycled-nylon shells marketed openly by Wildcraft, Skybags and newer DTC brands; 'eco' has moved from a claim on jute bags into mainstream backpack fabric.

The Sept-2025 GST rate rationalisation reset MRPs across bags, luggage, umbrellas and rainwear and forced re-stickering — treat any remembered slab or landed cost in this category as stale and re-confirm the current rate and the vendor's revised MRP before pricing the shelf.

Online discounting of 50-85% off MRP is now permanent on Flipkart/Amazon for bags, wallets and belts, which squeezes offline margin everywhere except captive locations like Baru Sahib — where a ~30-50 km trip to town is the real competitor, not the app.
adjacentServices: Bag, zip and wheel repair counter (local cobbler/tailor tie-up) — with no service centre inside 50 km, a ₹100 zip replacement saves a resident a whole trip to town and pulls footfall.

Name-marking service: embroidery, stencilling or engraved tags on hostel trunks, holdalls, laundry bags and school bags — a residential school with thousands of identical items needs this every April.

Institutional/Trust bulk supply: crested school bags, uniform belts, PT bags, sports kit bags and staff rainwear against Academy and University indents, quoted once a year rather than sold off the shelf.

May pre-book counter for the monsoon: take orders in April-May for kids' raincoats by size, gumboots by size and umbrellas, then bring one consolidated truck up the hill before the rain — this is the single highest-value service in this lane.
Term-start 'hostel kit' bundle (trunk + holdall + laundry bag + padlock + bucket) and a term-end left-luggage/storage locker service for students going home.
Monsoon umbrella and raincoat loan/deposit at the store or campus gate for visitors and day-trippers caught out in rain.
Reusable-bag deposit or bring-your-own-bag discount scheme at POS, plus a store-branded jhola that advertises on a closed campus.
Travel prep desk before vacation departures: luggage weighing, lock fitting, strap and tag sales, and suitcase rain covers.
Buy-back / exchange board for outgrown school bags, trunks and holdalls between outgoing and incoming boarders.

NOTE ON METHOD: the session's WebSearch quota was already exhausted (200/200) before this task started, so zero keyword searches ran — every price/brand/size figure above comes from the Flipkart category and search pages listed here. Margin bands, cohort mapping, seasonality, essentiality and all Baru-Sahib-specific reasoning (residential-school trunks, kirpan gatra, hill freight, May pre-book) are my inference from Indian retail norms and the brief, NOT scraped figures — treat them as judgement to be checked against ARY's own realised margins.
